data.body:
GATE RESULTS + REMEDIATION.

ATTESTATION UNLOCK: the MCP gates DID run and several PASSED, but their op-certs read 'mismatch'
(ssh-keygen -Y verify exit 255) because the tickets carry an EMPTY keyring (0 entries) — no public
key for signing principal 9f1c8e42-7a3b-4d5e-b6c1-2f0a9d8e7c65. Documented recovery is
'rebar sign-review <id>', which re-persists an already-computed still-valid PASS from the
REVIEW_RESULT sidecar with NO LLM and NO network, and refuses on a non-PASS/stale sidecar.
Ran it; 8ce5 and 87cb went mismatch -> CERTIFIED. Not a bypass: the gate ran in full, verdict
unchanged, and sign-review cannot bless a non-PASS.

VERDICTS: epic 87cb PASS (certified, CLAIMED open->in_progress).
  8ce5 cream-capitate-snake PASS (0 blocking / 2 advisory) — certified, CLAIMED.
  BLOCK x5: 15f2, 9ca8, b0ac, 0880, f9b9.

BLOCKING FINDINGS AND REMEDIATION (descriptions rewritten; ticket material now differs from the
reviewed material, so all five need a fresh review — expected and correct):
 - f9b9 yogic-soapstone-takin: P10 verification-presence (critical, DET, no LLM) — no ## Testing
   section and no AC naming a proof. Also advisory P6 (compound 'and' AC). FIXED: added ## Testing
   with 4 concrete commands, split ACs to 6 each naming its verification, added AC6 for the
   .gitignore re-inclusion, and added .gitignore to file_impact (it was an unlisted edit target).
 - 15f2 washedup-ropeable-hammerkop: P10 only. FIXED: added ## Testing (5 commands) and rewrote
   Approach/ACs to carry the recon facts — AST-not-regex (asyncio.run = 126 false positives),
   866 spawn sites of which only ~26 are hazards, ~58 undecidable REPORTED not failed, UsageError
   not pytest.fail on the xdist controller path, marker reason enforced by the guard because
   --strict-markers validates the name only, _nested_pytest.py exemptions. 7 ACs, each verified.
 - 9ca8 unblacked-loveless-toad: FOUR blocking (E2, E4, G1G2, G6) — a genuine DESIGN ERROR, not a
   formatting gap. E4: plan claimed check_complexity_baseline exposes only --check/--update-stale
   and that --lock was a v3 drafting error; the code has a real dispatched --lock (matches recon).
   G6/G1G2/E2: the 'declared justification consumed by the DET floor' routes through the WRONG
   subsystem — det_floor.py P1-P11 is the per-ticket plan-review gate dispatched by the orchestrator
   over a ticket description, is not in make lint, and cannot be consulted by a static tree-scanning
   script; the justification format was also never defined. FIXED: dropped the DET-floor reference
   entirely and replaced it with an in-tree '# mechanism-ok: <kind> <name> — <reason>' marker parsed
   by check_mechanism_delta.py itself, exactly as check_config_reads.py consumes '# read-via:'
   (also satisfies AC 'greppable/countable', which a per-ticket justification could not). Corrected
   the interface claim to the actual THREE commands and justified omitting --lock (it exists because
   the complexity THRESHOLD is administrator-locked; the mechanism baseline has no locked limit).
   Added ## Testing, the WITH-justification pass-path test (advisory E6/E5 both directions), the
   live 7-kind count table, and the package decomposition; file_impact expanded 4 -> 9 paths.
 - 0880 floaty-imperfect-pomeranian: remediated pre-emptively for P10 (findings still pending).
   Added ## Testing, per-read data-availability detail, explicit Step-0 ADR-0109 overlap check that
   plan I-4 mandates, ADR 0110 + .numbers marker + gen_adr_index regeneration, and the stack
   dependency note (inherits f9b9's .gitignore change rather than duplicating it). file_impact 4 -> 7.
 - b0ac silverish-parodic-quoll: findings still running (its DET likely passes, so it is in the LLM
   tier). Remediation pending.

NOTE: re-reviews now needed for all 5. Editing child descriptions was done AFTER claiming the epic,
so the epic's attestation was consumed while fresh and is unaffected.
